title: 18223 - 18223/P1815
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri from/to Pressure Control Valve 1 (N215) Artı (12V) Kutba Kısa Devre
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri from/to Pressure Control Valve 1 (N215)
technicalNotes:
Pressure Control Valve 1 (N215) might be referred to as Solenoid Valve 4 (N91)
Start with checking connectors for corrosion or water damage, in case of 01V transmission pay special attention to 16-pin connector between valve body and wiring harness.
